title: AI Interview System
description: An AI-powered interview platform that performs face verification, generates interview questions dynamically, evaluates answers, and creates performance reports for mock interview practice.
details: The AI Interview System is a Python-based smart interview platform developed using Streamlit, OpenCV, and Groq API integration. The system verifies users through webcam-based face detection before starting the interview, generates AI-based questions according to the selected topic and difficulty level, supports voice/text responses, analyzes answers using keyword and confidence analysis, calculates scores, and generates professional PDF performance reports with personalized feedback.

title: Market Data Scraping Dashboard
description: A Python automation dashboard that collects web data, cleans it into structured datasets, and presents useful reporting views.
details: Market Data Scraping Dashboard combines Python scraping scripts with scheduled cleanup and export logic. It is built for repeatable market research, lead enrichment, and listing-monitoring tasks where clean data matters more than raw volume.

title: Lead Management Flow System
description: A Salesforce admin build with guided lead routing, clean field structure, automated tasks, and practical CRM process improvements.
details: Lead Management Flow System focuses on making sales operations easier to follow. It includes clean object fields, simple page layouts, routing logic, and flow-driven reminders so teams can move leads forward without manual tracking.

title: Sales Performance Dashboard
description: A Salesforce reporting package for pipeline visibility, activity tracking, conversion trends, and sales performance reviews.
details: Sales Performance Dashboard organizes CRM metrics into useful dashboards for owners, managers, and sales users. The project emphasizes practical visibility: pipeline stages, conversion trends, activity follow-ups, and missed opportunities.

title: Responsive Portfolio Platform
description: A polished personal portfolio built with reusable sections, responsive layouts, smooth motion, and clear project storytelling.
details: Responsive Portfolio Platform is built as a polished personal brand system with focused sections, fast-loading UI, motion accents, and scalable content patterns for services, projects, and contact workflows.

title: Service Booking Interface
description: A clean booking experience for service businesses with guided steps, responsive layouts, practical forms, and conversion-focused UI.
details: Service Booking Interface turns a service funnel into a simple guided experience. It includes service cards, availability states, form validation patterns, and conversion-focused layouts designed for repeat use.

title: AI Resume Guide Platform
description: A multi-AI powered resume analysis platform that helps users evaluate resumes, identify missing skills, generate learning roadmaps, and prepare for interviews.
details: AI Resume Guide is a smart career assistant web application built with Flask, Python, SQLAlchemy, and multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, and DeepSeek. Users can sign up, upload resumes in PDF/DOCX format or manually enter content, select their preferred AI model, and receive structured career insights such as skill analysis, missing technologies, roadmap suggestions, and interview questions through an interactive dashboard.

title: AI Portfolio Assistant & Smart Meeting Scheduler
description: An AI-powered portfolio chatbot that answers queries about skills, projects, services, and intelligently schedules meetings using Cal.com API integration.
details: This AI Portfolio Assistant works as a real conversational chatbot integrated inside a modern developer portfolio. It provides smart responses about Mohmmad Sufian’s background, technical skills, projects, services, and automation work. The system includes a complete meeting scheduling flow powered by Cal.com API, where users can select available slots, book meetings, receive automated email confirmations, and generate Google Meet links automatically. The chatbot also handles lead collection, stores meeting information in structured JSON format, and creates a smooth interactive user experience with intelligent conversational flow and responsive UI design.
